assembly.name: Front brake corner (left)
assembly.description: Golf R Mk7 front brake: 340 × 30 mm ventilated disc with a single-piston floating (sliding) aluminium caliper, painted blue with the R script, on a cast carrier. Torque values are from the project dossier; OEM part numbers are not yet verified and are logged in docs/UNVERIFIED.md.

parts.name: Brake disc, front (340 × 30 mm ventilated)
parts.description: Ventilated front disc, 340 mm diameter × 30 mm thick (dossier §6), modelled with its real interfaces: 5×112 wheel-bolt pattern and 57.1 mm centre bore (dossier §5 wheel data), radial cooling vanes between the friction cheeks. Grey cast iron is typical for this application but the material is not stated in the dossier, so it is left unverified.

parts.name: Brake caliper housing, front (single-piston floating)
parts.description: Single-piston floating (sliding) caliper in aluminium, painted blue with the R script (dossier §6). Slides on guide pins in the carrier; one piston on the inboard side clamps both pads against the disc. Modelled following the disc curvature with bridge ribs, pad window, guide-pin ears and bleed nipple.

parts.name: Caliper carrier, front
parts.description: Carrier (bracket) bolted rigidly to the wheel bearing housing; the caliper slides on guide pins seated in the carrier and the pads locate in its machined abutments. Modelled in the real H-form: rails either side of the disc rim, over-rim bridges, and radial arms down to the two mounting ears. Material not stated in the dossier.

parts.name: Brake pad, front outer
parts.description: Outboard pad: steel backing plate with end lugs locating in the carrier abutments, bonded friction material. (Note from dossier §6: it is the REAR pads that are R-specific and not interchangeable with the GTI Performance Pack.)

parts.name: Brake pad, front inner
parts.description: Inboard pad, acted on directly by the caliper piston. Steel backing plate with end lugs and bonded friction material. Front-left pad position typically carries the wear sensor on VW models (sensor not modelled yet).

parts.name: Caliper guide bolts (caliper to carrier), M8 ×2
parts.description: Guide (slide) pin bolts securing the floating caliper to the carrier, seated in the caliper's guide-pin ears. Torque from dossier §2 table: caliper-to-carrier 35 Nm.

parts.name: Carrier bolts (carrier to bearing housing), M12 ×2
parts.description: Bolts fixing the caliper carrier's mounting ears to the wheel bearing housing. Torque from dossier §2 table: front caliper(-carrier)-to-bearing-housing 200 Nm. Replace-after-use status not stated in the dossier.
